crossRefs.note: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

translations.web: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
translations.bsb: The waters engulfed me to take my life; the watery depths closed around me; the seaweed wrapped around my head.
translations.kjv: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
translations.asv: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul; The deep was round about me; The weeds were wrapped about my head.
